events.text: ZDF broadcast the first episode, co-produced with ORF and SF DRS.

evidence.quote: On 14 February 1981 , the German channel ZDF broadcast the first episode

events.text: Contestant lit a pocket lighter using an excavator shovel on the show.

evidence.quote: Lighting a pocket lighter using an excavators shovel ( 19 February 1983 )

events.label: incident
events.text: Environmental activists ran in front of cameras with a banner during the 25th show.

evidence.quote: In the 25th show on 15 December 1984 , environmental activists ran in front of the cameras

events.label: bet
events.text: Frank Elstner lost a private bet set up by Kurt Felix on the 29th show.

evidence.quote: On the 29th show ( 21 September 1985 ) , after a successful outdoor challenge
revealed himself to the laughing audience as Kurt Felix in disguise

events.text: Frank Elstner ended his hosting with the 39th episode.

evidence.quote: hosted the show until its 39th episode in 1987

events.text: Celebrity bet-king selection by all bets ended; later replaced by phone vote.

evidence.quote: Until 1987 , each of the celebrities bet on all the performances

events.label: incident
events.text: Titanic editor Bernd Fritz cheated his way to winning a bet on the show.

evidence.quote: In the 48th show on 3 September 1988 , an editor of the German satirical magazine Titanic

events.text: Contestants assembled and ran a V8 engine within nine minutes on the show.

evidence.quote: Assembling a V8 engine from parts and making it run within 9 minutes ( 2 November 1991 )

events.text: Gottschalk's hosting interval began; Wolfgang Lippert presented nine episodes.

evidence.quote: from 1992 to 1993 , when nine episodes were presented by Wolfgang Lippert

events.label: bet
events.text: Whoopi Goldberg lost a bet and cast Gottschalk in her next movie.

evidence.quote: In a show in 1992 , actress Whoopi Goldberg came onto the show for a bet

events.text: Gottschalk's hosting interval ended; he returned as host.

evidence.quote: from 1992 to 1993 , when nine episodes were presented by Wolfgang Lippert

events.text: Thirteen swimmers towed a 312-tonne ship 25 meters on the show.

evidence.quote: 13 swimmers towing a 312-tonne ship over a distance of 25 meters ( 7 October 1995 )

events.label: incident
events.text: Planned live bet with cosmonauts on Mir failed due to technical problems.

evidence.quote: In the 102nd show on 8 December 1996 , a live bet at the Russian space station Mir was planned

events.text: Host began betting against the entire host city instead of audience bets.

evidence.quote: Since 2001 , the host bets against the entire city where the show is held

events.text: Contestant recognised 5 of 6 bird species blindfolded by feather.

evidence.quote: Recognising 5 of 6 ( out of a total of 75 ) species of birds blindfolded by feeling a single feather ( 9 November 2002 )

events.text: Gottschalk hosted the show's 100th episode.

evidence.quote: Gottschalk hosted his 100th episode of the show on 27 March 2004

events.text: Show first broadcast in widescreen format.

evidence.quote: In summer 2007 , Wetten , dass.. ? had its first show in widescreen

events.label: guest appearance
events.text: Salma Hayek appeared; Dirndl bet with a boy and beer crates.

evidence.quote: She appeared on the show on 5 October 2008

events.text: Michelle Hunziker began assisting Gottschalk in hosting.

evidence.quote: Since late 2009 , Michelle Hunziker has assisted Gottschalk in hosting the show

events.text: First show broadcast in HD.

evidence.quote: The show on 27 February 2010 was the first show broadcast in HD

events.label: accident
events.text: Samuel Koch became quadriplegic during a live stunt on the show.

evidence.quote: a stunt which he performed on the show on 4 December 2010
Samuel Koch , a 23-year-old aspiring stuntman , became a quadriplegic during a stunt performed on the show on 4 December 2010

events.text: Episode interrupted and terminated prematurely, first time in show history.

evidence.quote: performed on the show on 4 December 2010
The episode was interrupted and terminated prematurely about 20 minutes later

events.text: Thomas Gottschalk left the show as host after the Koch accident.

evidence.quote: Thomas Gottschalk left the show on 3 December 2011

events.text: ZDF announced Markus Lanz would be the next presenter.

evidence.quote: ZDF announced on 11 March 2012 that Markus Lanz would be the next presenter

events.text: Markus Lanz took over hosting with his first show.

evidence.quote: His first show was on 6 October 2012
Markus Lanz took over the hosting of the show ( debuting on 6 October 2012 )

events.text: Cancellation at end of 2014 announced after the Offenburg show.

evidence.quote: with the conclusion of the 2014 Offenburg show ( 5 April 2014 ) , it was announced that the show would be cancelled

events.text: The 215th and last regular show was broadcast from Nuremberg.

evidence.quote: the last show was on 13 December 2014
The 215th and last regular show was broadcast on 13 December 2014 from Nuremberg

events.text: Show rebooted as satirical homage with fake bets, hosted by Jan Böhmermann.

evidence.quote: The show was rebooted as a satirical homage with fake bets in 2016

events.text: ZDF announced a one-evening revival of the show.

evidence.quote: On 28 July 2018 , ZDF announced a one-evening revival of Wetten , dass..?
